item.title: [7.9] Indian bonds tumble on oil surge, RBI rate hike fears
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds experienced a decline as the benchmark yield exceeded 7.45% on Thursday. Oil prices rose significantly, reaching $112.50 per barrel in Asian trading amid geopolitical tensions. The Reserve Bank of India has raised its repo rate to 5.50%, indicating a potential for further hikes.

WHY IT MATTERS

The combination of surging oil prices, an aggressive RBI rate hike to 5.50%, and breached bond yields represents a critical macro shock for Indian markets and emerging market debt.

item.description:
